userStories.title: Split conversation_terminal.go — agent-loop core to internal/agent, thin Telegram edit wrapper stays
userStories.description: internal/telegram/conversation_terminal.go (68 LOC) has 2 functions: FinalizeTerminalTool(ctx, c tele.Context, convCtx, userID, placeholder *tele.Message, rawToolResult, stats) — exported entry point; finalizeTerminalToolWithNoToolLLM(...same args) — does an LLM round without tools then edits the placeholder.
